body.zh-Hant: 德國國家圖書館權威檔記載艾莫·卡揚德爾生於1879年4月4日，1943年1月21日卒於赫爾辛基。權威檔把他的職業列為森林科學家、植物學家與政治人物，並註明他在1922至1924年與1937至1939年擔任芬蘭總理。
body.en: The German National Library authority record gives Aimo Cajander's birth as 4 April 1879 and his death in Helsinki on 21 January 1943. It lists his occupations as forest scientist, botanist and politician, and notes that he was Finnish prime minister in 1922–1924 and 1937–1939.

body.zh-Hant: 德國國家圖書館權威檔記他1937至1939年任芬蘭總理。庫魯麥基的論文說，當時各方無法就總理人選達成一致，折衷方案是把總理一職交給國家進步黨及其黨魁卡揚德爾；這個政府的組成首度跨越內戰時白軍與紅軍的分界。1939年11月冬季戰爭爆發後，他的政府總辭。
body.en: The German National Library authority record gives him as Finnish prime minister in 1937–1939. Kolumäki writes that when the parties could not agree on who should become prime minister, the compromise was to give the post to the National Progressive Party and its leader Cajander, and that this government crossed the Civil War dividing line between Whites and Reds for the first time. When the Winter War broke out in November 1939, his government resigned.

body.zh-Hant: 德國國家圖書館權威檔記載雷菲克·塞達姆生於1881年9月8日，出生地與1942年7月8日的卒地都記為伊斯坦堡，職業為政治人物、政府首腦與軍醫。希姆謝克的論文說他生於伊斯坦堡，從軍醫學校以「醫官上尉」軍階畢業，後在居爾哈內軍事醫學院工作三年，並通過選拔被派往德國進修。
body.en: The German National Library authority record gives Refik Saydam's birth as 8 September 1881 and records Istanbul as both his birthplace and place of death (8 July 1942); it lists his occupations as politician, head of government and military physician. Şimşek's article says he was born in Istanbul, graduated from the Military Medical School with the rank of medical captain, worked three years at the Gülhane Military Medical Academy, and passed an examination that sent him to Germany for training.

body.zh-Hant: 希姆謝克記載，土耳其共和國宣布成立後，塞達姆於1923年10月30日在第一次伊斯麥特帕夏政府出任衛生部長，並在第二次伊斯麥特帕夏政府續任到1924年11月21日；1925年3月4日在第三次伊斯麥特帕夏政府再度出任，這次一直做到1937年10月25日。他也在1925年8月8日出任紅新月會（Kızılay）總會長，並於1928年創辦衛生研究所與衛生學校。
body.en: Şimşek records that after the proclamation of the Republic, Saydam was made health minister on 30 October 1923 in İsmet Pasha's first government and kept the post in the second İsmet Pasha government until 21 November 1924; on 4 March 1925 he was appointed again in the third İsmet Pasha government and stayed until 25 October 1937. He also became head of the Red Crescent (Kızılay) on 8 August 1925 and, in 1928, opened the Hygiene Institute and Hygiene School.

heading.en: Interior minister, prime minister and death

body.zh-Hant: 阿克薩卡爾的論文記載，在凱末爾逝世後一天，即1938年11月11日成立的第二次巴亞爾政府中，塞達姆被任命為內政部長，並出任共和人民黨總書記。1939年1月25日巴亞爾辭去總理後，總統伊諾努任命他接任總理。希姆謝克記載他於1942年7月8日因心臟病發逝世，在位時恰逢第二次世界大戰。
body.en: Aksakal's article records that in the second Bayar government formed on 11 November 1938, a day after Atatürk's death, Saydam was made interior minister and secretary-general of the Republican People's Party. When Bayar resigned as prime minister on 25 January 1939, President İnönü appointed him prime minister. Şimşek records that he died of a heart attack on 8 July 1942, while the Second World War was under way.

body.zh-Hant: 弗蘭斯·斯霍拉爾特生於1851年8月19日的維爾瑟勒，1917年6月29日卒於法國圣阿德雷斯。《法蘭德斯運動百科》記他1875年在魯汶取得法學博士，之後在當地執業律師；1888年6月起，他由魯汶選區選入眾議院，並於1890年共同創辦比利時農民同盟。
body.en: Frans Schollaert was born in Wilsele on 19 August 1851 and died at Sainte-Adresse in France on 29 June 1917. The Encyclopedie van de Vlaamse Beweging says he took his law doctorate at Leuven in 1875 and then practised there as a lawyer; from June 1888 he was returned to the Chamber for the Leuven district, and in 1890 he co-founded the Belgian Boerenbond.

heading.zh-Hant: 內政部長與眾議院議長
heading.en: Interior minister and president of the Chamber

body.zh-Hant: 《比屬殖民傳記》記載，斯霍拉爾特1895年5月25日在布爾萊內閣出任內政部長，任到1899年8月。1900年他出任眾議院副議長，1901年升任議長；《法蘭德斯運動百科》記他的議長任期為1901年11月至1908年1月。1906年12月，他又主持為審議殖民地制度法案而設的十七人委員會。
body.en: The Biographie Coloniale Belge records that on 25 May 1895 Schollaert took the interior portfolio in the Burlet cabinet and ran that department until August 1899. In 1900 he became vice-president of the Chamber and in 1901 its president; the Encyclopedie van de Vlaamse Beweging dates this presidency from November 1901 to January 1908. In December 1906 he also took the chair of the Commission of Seventeen on the colonial regime bill.

heading.en: Prime minister and the annexation of the Congo

body.zh-Hant: 1907年12月31日首相德特魯茲去世後，斯霍拉爾特由國王選為政府首腦，內閣組成不變。1908年1月14日，他向眾議院宣布政府將對剛果移轉條約中站得住腳的異議作出讓步。《法蘭德斯運動百科》記他在1908至1910年兼任內政與農業部長，1910至1911年任藝術與科學部長；1909年12月14日，他把軍事兵役法案送請國王批准。
body.en: After Prime Minister de Trooz died on 31 December 1907, Schollaert was chosen by the King to head the government and left the ministerial team unchanged. On 14 January 1908 he told the Chamber that the government would meet the objections it judged well founded in the Congo cession treaty. The Encyclopedie van de Vlaamse Beweging records him as minister of the Interior and of Agriculture in 1908–1910 and of Arts and Sciences in 1910–1911; on 14 December 1909 he submitted the military service law for the King's sanction.

heading.en: President of the Chamber again and exile at Le Havre

body.zh-Hant: 1912年11月起，斯霍拉爾特再度出任眾議院議長，直到1917年6月；1914年入侵發生時，他隨政府前往法國，並在當地逝世，沒能見到國家重獲解放。《法蘭德斯運動百科》另指出，他曾長年擔任大衛基金會副會長，但作為法蘭德斯運動者的重要性不大。
body.en: From November 1912 Schollaert was again president of the Chamber, until June 1917; when the invasion came in 1914 he went with the government to France and died there, before the country was liberated. The Encyclopedie van de Vlaamse Beweging adds that he was for years vice-president of the Davidsfonds, but that his importance as a Flemish-movement figure was slight.
